Players Committee card image of [[Wokling (V) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “Unless Massassi Throne Room on table, deploy on table. Your total Force generation is +1. Once per game, may use 3 Force to take an Effect that has no deploy cost and deploys on another card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect out of play to retrieve 1 Force. [Immune to Alter.]”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/wokling.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 ab74419] (31 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
